vc_sentences: N02 (row 5): Field Explanation now names the DIAN document-type code source (Field Options table 'Tipo de documento (numerals 2 and 34)'), the one-column-per-document-type structure of the client master data with a priority rule, the retention of identity for leavers and employer-paid pensioners, and the 8 persons with no identity in any report; Option Values now points to that table.

N03 (row 6): Field Explanation now maps the four name sub-fields to the client master-data columns (Last Name, Second Last Name, First Name, Middle Name) and requires the four parts to be retained for leavers and employer-paid pensioners.

N04 (row 7): Field Explanation now states that the DIVIPOLA department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) codes must be held as master data or converted through a validated mapping, because the client holds a letter department code and a free-text city; the value for a foreign address is referred to RA.

N05 (row 9): Field Explanation now defines the salary scope (CST art. 127, integral salary reported at 100%), feeds the numeral from a wage-type-to-numeral classification rather than the payroll salary flag, and requires calendar-year accumulation by payment date.

N08 (row 12) and N19 (row 24): Field Explanation unchanged; queries to RA added in column T on the numeral-7 routing of the in-kind meal benefit where salary exceeds 310 UVT and on the tax year of the February severance deposit and its mirror wage types (decision 9).

N12 (row 16): Field Explanation now lists the statutory benefits in scope (legal service bonus, vacation pay in its three forms, work clothing), feeds the numeral from the wage-type classification with exclusion from N05, and refers the placement of extralegal bonuses to RA.
N13 (row 17): Field Explanation now names the per-diem wage types as the source and refers the routing of salary-type per diems (N13 or N05) to RA.

N17 (row 21): Field Explanation now lists the kinds of work income with no dedicated numeral, excludes advances, loans and reimbursements, and requires per-wage-type classification of in-kind and foreign-paid items confirmed with RA.

N21 (row 27): Field Explanation now states that employer-paid pensions are populated (at PMI the employer pays company pensions directly to pensioners not present in the master data) and that lump-sum retirement payments are classified per wage type with RA; the ET art. 206 num. 5 threshold is unchanged.
N23 (row 30): Field Explanation now names the employee EPS contribution wage type as the source, forbids a combined EPS+AFP+FSP figure, and refers pensioner health deductions to RA.

N24 (row 31): Field Explanation now names the employee AFP and FSP wage types (solidarity and subsistence sub-accounts) as the source, forbids a combined EPS+AFP+FSP figure, and refers the pensioner solidarity deduction to RA.

N25 (row 32): Field Explanation now requires the wage-type attribute 'RAIS voluntary (art. 55)' and lists the PMI voluntary-pension wage types to be classified by the client (FVOL 25811-25815, 25823; institutional plan 25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803, 65804).

N26 (row 33): Field Explanation now requires the wage-type attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)', lists the same PMI wage types to be classified, and requires employer and employee institutional-plan contributions to be told apart.

N27 (row 34): Field Explanation now defines the amount as the employee's AFC contributions withheld through payroll by payment date, summed across the per-bank AFC wage types, and refers the treatment of AFC reimbursements to RA.

N29 (row 37): Field Explanation now defines the amount as the withholding actually practised by payment date, names the candidate wage types at PMI (income tax, terminations, retirees, equity awards) and the September evidence (255 of 261 on the income-tax wage type, 6 on the theoretical wage type), and includes theoretical or hypothetical amounts only where actually withheld and declared on Form 350.

N32 (row 41): Field Explanation now states the monthly per-employee computation of the amount up to 41 UVT, limited to months in which salary does not exceed 310 UVT, and names the meal-in-kind wage type as the source subject to client confirmation.

ENV-03 (row 49): Field Explanation now states that every amount numeral is the sum of payments made between 1 January and 31 December of the tax year by payment date, never a rolling twelve-month accumulator.
9 section-header and separator cells stored as formulas (rendered as #NAME? in Excel) converted to plain text in: Formato 2276 Spec, Sample File. No content change.
